object_description: articulated volume with a shortened north wing and a windowless head front to the street
geometry_property: windowless front facade at the head
design_condition: the volume is shaped to answer the different scales of the busy street and the small-scale residential area, its shortened north wing strengthening the spatial relationship between park and recreation area

positive: Shortening and shifting the north wing strengthens the spatial relationship between park and recreation area
The deliberate sculptural response to the different scales of street, playground and residential area is a major quality
The design and dimensions of the new entrance hall are impressive
As the central link it has the necessary spaciousness and mediates skilfully between the different scales
Simplifying the surrounding design achieves the desired effect on the playground
The playground appears more spacious and spans the entire length of the building without losing retreat options
The functional facade expression is based on the history of the site as a former industrial area
The jury can imagine a photovoltaic facade at this location
Relieving the roof surfaces of photovoltaic panels is a positive side effect next to the two high-rise buildings
Convincing urban design with a balanced relationship between building height and open spaces
The scale is appropriate for an elementary school
negative: The offset and windowless front facade creating a head situation cannot be understood by the jury
Proof of the aesthetic and maintenance longevity of the photovoltaic facade still needs to be provided
A stronger emphasis on the building as an important public building towards the street is desired
